cards.statement: Notice: Keep the door closed because air-conditioning is in use. Statement: The door should remain open.
cards.explanation: Keep closed pide mantenerla cerrada.

cards.statement: Notice: Return laptops by 5 p.m. Statement: Users may keep laptops overnight.
cards.explanation: El aviso exige devolverlos ese día.

cards.statement: Notice: Late applications are considered for the next course. Statement: A late application is automatically destroyed.
cards.explanation: El aviso dice que se considera más tarde, no que se destruya.

cards.statement: Notice: No food or drink in the computer room. Statement: Eating is allowed there.
cards.explanation: No food prohíbe comer.

cards.statement: Notice: The meeting moved to Room 4. Statement: Room 4 is the new meeting place.
cards.explanation: Moved to comunica el nuevo lugar.

cards.statement: Notice: Bring photo ID to collect your parcel after 4 p.m. Statement: Any document is acceptable.
cards.explanation: Photo ID especifica el tipo de documento requerido.

cards.statement: Notice: The train leaves from Platform 6 instead of Platform 2. Statement: The departure platform has changed.
cards.explanation: Instead of marca un cambio respecto a la plataforma original.

cards.statement: Notice: The workshop is free but places must be booked in advance. Statement: No booking is needed because it is free.
cards.explanation: But contrasta gratuidad con reserva obligatoria.

cards.statement: Notice: Members may borrow three books for up to four weeks. Statement: Members may borrow unlimited books.
cards.explanation: Three books limita la cantidad.

cards.statement: Notice: Reception is closed at lunch; leave a message in the box. Statement: Visitors can speak to reception during lunch.
cards.explanation: Closed at lunch significa que no se puede hablar allí en ese periodo.

cards.statement: Notice: The pool is closed until 10 June for cleaning. Statement: Cleaning is the reason for closure.
cards.explanation: For cleaning expresa la causa.

cards.statement: Notice: Paper copies will not be accepted; applications must be emailed. Statement: Email is the required channel.
cards.explanation: Must be emailed expresa la forma obligatoria de envío.

cards.statement: Notice: Lost property should be handed in at reception within 24 hours. Statement: Found items should be given to reception promptly.
cards.explanation: Handed in within 24 hours se parafrasea como entregar pronto.

cards.statement: Notice: Residents should report water leaks to the building manager immediately. Statement: The notice is addressed to residents.
cards.explanation: Residents aparece como destinatario explícito.

cards.statement: Notice: Renewals after 31 August include a £5 administration fee. Statement: Late renewals cost exactly the same.
cards.explanation: Include a fee significa que se añade un coste.

cards.statement: Notice: A booking may be changed once if space is available. Statement: It may be changed as many times as needed.

cards.statement: Notice: Last orders at 9:30; café closes at 10. Statement: Final orders are before closing.
cards.explanation: Last orders fija una hora anterior al cierre.

cards.statement: Notice: Staff only beyond this point. Statement: All visitors may continue.
cards.explanation: Staff only excluye a visitantes.

cards.statement: Notice: Use the side entrance while flooring work is being completed. Statement: The instruction is temporary.
cards.explanation: While work is being completed indica una situación temporal.

cards.statement: Notice: Use the stairs because the lift is out of order. Statement: The lift is working normally.
cards.explanation: Out of order significa que no funciona.

cards.statement: Notice: Queue on the right; appointment holders may go to the desk. Statement: People with appointments must always queue.

cards.statement: Notice: The shop opens late due to staff training. Statement: Staff training is mentioned as the cause.

cards.statement: Notice: The bus will not stop here between 8 and 9 a.m.; use Oak Road. Statement: Oak Road is an alternative during that hour.
cards.explanation: El aviso ofrece Oak Road para el intervalo indicado.

cards.statement: Notice: Tickets online from Monday. Statement: Online sales start on Monday.
